text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (two xe.com conversions to USD, a timeanddate city lookup, then an email to procurement with the \"Quotes: {item}\" subject and comparison body) and splits each quote into separate amount and currency parameters, which is fine; but its last step says \"send or discard\" when the workflow says discard and never send, and it adds a time zone to the body and a \"cheaper supplier\" detail that aren't in the true workflow."}

data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (two xe.com conversions to USD, a timeanddate city lookup, then an email to procurement with the "Quotes: {item}" subject and comparison body) and splits each quote into separate amount and currency parameters, which is fine; but its last step says "send or discard" when the workflow says discard and never send, and it adds a time zone to the body and a "cheaper supplier" detail that aren't in the true workflow.
